semantic_controls: MERGE and ON CONFLICT are not called idempotent without source uniqueness and a business-key invariant
NOT VALID/VALIDATE CONSTRAINT is scoped to PostgreSQL behavior and does not imply zero locking
logical rewrite, plan generation and execution are separated; a bad plan is not attributed to one cause without evidence
planner costs are dimensionless estimates, not elapsed milliseconds
join algorithm heuristics are predictions, not universal winner rules
work_mem applies per eligible operation and can multiply under concurrency
selectivities are not blindly multiplied when columns are correlated; extended statistics limitations remain explicit
the multicolumn B-tree leftmost rule is stated with PostgreSQL 17 skip-scan nuance, not as an absolute cannot-use claim
index-only scan requires index coverage and heap-page visibility
zero idx_scan is not sufficient evidence to drop an index
coursera: not used; deferred to module construction by owner policy
